'''''Z-Coral''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] used [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], it was part of an attempt to loot [[ZA-13]]. It was carrying [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] parts. However it was disabled by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], then boarded by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] boarding parties to recover the cargo, before being destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
The ship was called ''Z-Coral'' to remind the player it belonged to Zaarin.
